name: product-copier-salla
description: Chrome MV3 extension that copies products from any e-commerce page into a Salla store, with optional Gemini-powered Arabic rewriting and brand-template image normalisation.

scripts.syntax: for f in background.js content_copy.js popup.js options.js paste_salla.js; do node --check "$f"; done
scripts.check: npm run syntax && npm run lint && npm run check:versions
